subject: Can we add a word white document on shiny app?

messages.author: d73845baa9e259e5
messages.subject: Can we add a word white document on shiny app?
parts:
Hi,

I would like to know if there is a solution to have, on a shiny app,
a word document ( or simple bloc notes)
in which we could add notes and then save them on the app and download it on a machine.

Thanks

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Can we add a word white document on shiny app?
parts:
You can certainly render a Word document from R Markdown (e.g. the
example "Download knitr reports" at
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/), but I don't think you can just
embed a Word document on an HTML page and edit it directly like Google
Docs.

Regards,
Yihui
